summary: The reading copies are coherent and preserve the checkpoint’s major hooks, but the durable state drops Taekyung’s concealed Fire Gate–related facts. There is also a recap mismatch between Chapters 173 and 174, several noncompliant ASCII ellipses in Chapter 173, two awkward cultivation-style collocations, and one System-term capitalization drift.
